result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers sort all 11 topic toggles into sensible named sections and put the global controls first. B's mockup is easier to build from: it shows the order, the default for every toggle, the quiet-hours schedule and the masters disabling the rows beneath them. A calls out frost alerts as time-sensitive more explicitly. B separates marketing more clearly by placing it last and defaulting it off, and it adds the point about consent rules for marketing email. A's top section is vaguer: it offers 'pause all' or the two masters without choosing, and its 'Summaries' section holds only one toggle. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers sort all 14 real toggles into topic sections, put the master switches and quiet hours at the top, and grey out rows when a master is off. A's mockup shows the order and a default for every toggle, with marketing off and essentials on, and it adds a consent note for marketing email. B says plainly why frost alerts are time-sensitive and collapses News & offers by default, but it leaves 'Summaries' as a section with one item and is vaguer about defaults.
